title: a little bit of home
tagline: Recipes from my childhood in Durban, South Africa.

lines: Hey, I'm Shernice! Welcome to my recipe app—my little digital slice of home.

Growing up in Durban, South Africa, gave me a wildly adventurous palate, but ever since moving to the US, I've been seriously craving the flavors I grew up with. So, I decided to roll up my sleeves and start cooking up my all-time favorites (and finally trying out a few dishes I missed out on back in the day!).

I wanted to build a fun space to save and share these recipes with you all. I know I'm not the only one who misses that comforting taste of home, so hopefully, we can all share a little piece of our worlds here!
hello.ps: P.S. I am definitely not a master chef, but hey, I give it my absolute best shot!

note.heading: A note from me
lines: I'm so excited to experience everyone's a little bit of home!
